notes: At the start there are no AOs: brigades you deploy stage at Camp Doha until you set up AOs and assign them. Auto on the deploy screen only appears once an AO exists, and only ever reinforces a standing AO
Brigades without an AO are no longer given one automatically
If anything goes wrong while drawing the map, the map now recovers on the next frame instead of staying with missing cities and bases, and the error is logged
